playful.dialogue.location.ruined_portal_: Marvel at the shattered remnants of a portal, nestled amidst the endless dunes of this forsaken desert. Its destruction serves as a stark reminder of the desert's merciless grip on all who dare cross its path.

Behold, dear friend! A ruined portal gracing the center of this ghastly swamp. I can't help but chuckle at the thought of those Nether invaders expecting a grand entrance, only to be met with the reality of this squalid dump. Quite the amusing turn of events, wouldn't you say?
playful.dialogue.location.ruined_portal/: Oh boy, you won't believe what's waiting for you at %2$s - a ruined portal straight out of a horror movie! I mean, seriously, it's like the Nether paid a visit and left its fiery mark. Scary stuff, if you ask me!

Hey, guess what? If you're up for a little adventure, check out %2$s. There's this completely wrecked nether portal that'll give you goosebumps! I mean, it's like the Nether had a fiery party and this place is the aftermath. But don't worry, it's safe... I think.

So, word around here is that %2$s is home to some seriously ancient ruins. Rumor has it, it used to be a nether portal. But let me tell you, buddy, it's not just any ordinary ruins. It's like... cursed or something! People say there might even be treasure hidden inside, but honestly, I wouldn't touch it with a ten-foot pole!
playful.dialogue.location.ruined_portal_: Guess what? There's a ruined portal in the mountains, right at %2$s! It's like Mother Nature's twisted sense of humor decided to play a prank on unsuspecting travelers.
playful.dialogue.location.mansion/1: Oh, let me tell you something juicy! There's this wickedly cursed mansion at %2$s, infested with those ghastly illagers. Trust me, darling, if you hold any value for your precious little life, steer clear of that wretched place.
playful.dialogue.location.mansion/2: Listen up, my friend. Picture this
playful.dialogue.location.monument/1: Hey there, adventurer! Rumor has it there's a sunken castle chilling out near %2$s, but trust me, you'd better bring your floaties and steer clear of those sneaky sea monsters. They're a feisty bunch!
playful.dialogue.location.monument/2: Ahoy, matey! I've heard whispers of some ancient ruins lurking beneath the ocean depths near %2$s. They say there's treasure waiting to be discovered, but be warned – danger lurks around every seaweed-covered corner. Are you ready to dive into the unknown?
playful.dialogue.location.shipwreck/1: Ahoy there, matey! Feast your eyes upon the majestic shipwreck I discovered at %2$s. That sunken vessel once sailed under the flag of the mighty Eastern Alliance Company, aye!
playful.dialogue.location.shipwreck/2: Avast, me hearties! Word on the high seas is that some lucky fishermen stumbled upon a shipwreck at %2$s. I'm positively itching to know if there be some hidden treasure waiting to be plundered... Yo ho ho!
playful.dialogue.location.shipwreck_beac: Ahoy there, matey! I stumbled upon a shipwrecked beauty at %2$s, right on the sandy shores. It's quite the sight, you won't be able to resist its allure!
Avast, me hearties! Head on over to %2$s and feast your eyes upon a shipwreck stranded on the beach. It's a mysterious tale, that one. I can't help but ponder how it got there, arrr!
playful.dialogue.location.village_desert: Who would have thought? Right here in this unforgiving desert, you'll stumble upon a village that will steal your heart in an instant!
playful.dialogue.location.village_taiga/: Ah, behold! In the vast expanse of the taiga biome lies another enchanting village, just waiting to be discovered!
Venture forth, my friend, into the heart of the magnificent taiga biome, and lo and behold, you shall stumble upon another village of wondrous charm!
playful.dialogue.location.village_snowy/: Hey, did you know there's a chilly little village over yonder at %2$s? Brrr, it's like an icebox over there!
Psst, listen up! If you make your way to %2$s, you'll find this frosty village in the snowy plains. The people there are friendly as ever, but man, it's colder than a penguin's freezer!
playful.dialogue.location.village_plains: Oh, you won't believe what lies ahead at %2$s! There's another charming village just waiting to be discovered.
Brace yourself, my dear friend, for beyond the vast plain at %2$s lies a hidden gem - another village, bustling with life and excitement.
playful.dialogue.location.village_savann: Whoa, if you head on over to %2$s, you'll find another village baking in the scorching sun! Trust me, you'll need SPF 1000!
Hey there, adventurer! Take a trip to the savanna at %2$s and you'll stumble upon a sizzling village filled with the friendliest folks ever. Prepare to be dazzled!
playful.dialogue.location.swamp_hut/1: You won't catch me dead near that swampy mess at %2$s. There's this wicked witch dwelling there, and I suggest you steer clear if you value your sanity.
playful.dialogue.location.swamp_hut/2: Forget about %2$s, my friend. That swamp is home to the most notorious witch in all of Minecraft. If you have any sense, you'll make a wide arc around that cursed place.
playful.dialogue.location.mineshaft/1: Ah, the tales of that cursed mine! There used to be a thriving excavation site here, until disaster struck! Legends say, one poor soul dug too greedily and a mighty cave-in ensued, sealing the mine's fate forever. Seek ye answers within, if ye dare, at %2$s.
playful.dialogue.location.mineshaft/2: Prepare yourself for a spine-chilling tale, my dear friend! In ages past, a mine stood proudly in these very depths, but alas, a calamity of monstrous proportions befell it! Word has it, fearsome creatures now lurk in the shadows, turning it into a treacherous labyrinth. Should you choose to venture forth, remember - danger dances in every step! Find this accursed mine at %2$s.
playful.dialogue.location.jungle_pyramid: Have you heard about the cursed temple at %2$s? It's like a deathtrap waiting to gobble up unsuspecting adventurers. I'd steer clear if I were you. Unless, of course, you have a thing for danger, then be my guest.

Ah, %2$s, the infamous jungle ruins. Legends say it's teeming with ancient traps that can outsmart even the cleverest of minds. If you're feeling adventurous, it might be worth a visit. Just remember, those traps have claimed more lives than I can count. But hey, who am I to stop you?
playful.dialogue.location.pillager_outpo: Oh boy, you won't believe what's happening at %2$s. The Pillagers have decided to grace us with their lovely presence by setting up an outpost right next door. Great, just what we needed. Another round of attacks. Can't they find a hobby or something?

So, word on the street is that there's an outpost owned by those lovely Pillagers at %2$s. Let me warn you, my friend, those guys have zero manners. If you dare to go anywhere near that place, prepare for a not-so-friendly arrow in the knee. Just saying.

Ah, %2$s, the land of the brave and the outpost of the wicked Pillagers. You know, if you're feeling up for a challenge, you might want to pay them a visit. Who knows, maybe you'll even find some shiny loot as a reward. But fair warning, our entire village would be eternally grateful if you rid us of those pesky troublemakers. No pressure though, just saying.
playful.dialogue.location.ancient_city/0: Oh, let me tell you, I was strolling around %2$s and suddenly I heard the strangest noises echoing from the depths of the earth. It was like the secrets of the ancient city were whispering to me!
playful.dialogue.location.ancient_city/1: You won't believe what I discovered while exploring %2$s. My instincts tell me that there's something extraordinary lurking far beneath the surface. I can almost feel the ancient city's presence calling out to me.
playful.dialogue.location.ancient_city/3: Legends, my dear friend, legends! They speak of an ancient city nestled within the very heart of %2$s. Although my eyes failed to catch a glimpse, I can't shake the feeling that this hidden treasure lies beneath the ground, waiting to be discovered by an adventurous soul like yourself.
playful.dialogue.joke.monster.success/1: Haha! That Skelly got what it deserved, served with a side of justice!
playful.dialogue.joke.monster.success/2: A zombie tried to hit you with a shovel? Hah!
playful.dialogue.joke.monster.success/3: You showed that spider who's boss. Nice one!
playful.dialogue.joke.monster.success/4: You got a skeleton to shoot a creeper? That's clever!
playful.dialogue.joke.monster.success/5: Hah! Those cave spiders forgot how to spider!
playful.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/1: Skeletons can fight back, you know. It's not quite so funny up close.
playful.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/2: Another joke about exploding creepers? I've heard it.
playful.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/3: Zombies and skeletons might once have been people. Strange thought, isn't it?
playful.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/4: An enderman falling into water? Stop the presses!
playful.dialogue.joke.monster.failed/5: Another silverfish-in-the-privy joke? I'd demand an emerald for every one.
playful.dialogue.joke.animal.success/1: Poor sheep lost its wool! At least it can try the breezy look.
playful.dialogue.joke.animal.success/2: A wolf in love with a sheep? That's a tale I'd like to hear!
playful.dialogue.joke.animal.success/3: You won't believe this, but chickens have secretly been taking improv classes. Yeah, they're cracking hilarious jokes now! Who knew they had such comedic talent hidden under those feathers?
playful.dialogue.joke.animal.success/4: That's a special kind of dumb that's so dumb, it's genius! I mean, who needs logic when you can have a good laugh, am I right?
playful.dialogue.joke.animal.success/5: Cows and their endless milk! Udderly wonderful!
playful.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/1: Oh, come on! Lighten up, will ya? Ain't nobody gonna get hurt by a little joke!
playful.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/2: Bah, you're such a buzzkill! That sheep joke was baa-d, but it's all in good fun!
playful.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/3: Leave my pig out of it! He has feelings, probably.
playful.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/4: That joke was a little rough, but I'll give you points for daring.
playful.dialogue.joke.animal.failed/5: A cow's eyebrows? That's a new one!
playful.dialogue.flirt.slap/1: Well, aren't you just a precious little troublemaker!
playful.dialogue.flirt.slap/2: Did you learn to flirt from a vindicator? Try being less frightening.
playful.dialogue.kiss.slap/2: Give it another shot, and you'll be wearing a souvenir of my wrath!
playful.dialogue.story.exploring.success: I'd love to go exploring like that someday. Think of the treasure!
Your adventures make me want to set out and find some of my own.
You, my friend, are an explorer extraordinaire! Venturing into the great unknown, facing danger with a mischievous grin, and leaving no stone unturned. I salute your courageous spirit!
playful.dialogue.story.exploring.fail/1: Your tales are more worn out than a creeper's explosion radius.
playful.dialogue.story.exploring.fail/2: Trying to sound tough, are we? Careful!
playful.dialogue.story.exploring.fail/3: I'm afraid I don't quite believe that story.
playful.dialogue.story.nether.success/1: Is it really that hot in the Nether? I can barely take a campfire!
playful.dialogue.story.nether.success/2: You survived the Nether? That's quite the adventure!
playful.dialogue.story.nether.success/3: They say the Nether has treasure everywhere. If only I weren't so scared of it!
playful.dialogue.story.nether.success/4: Weren't you frightened in the Nether? I'd be trembling!
playful.dialogue.story.nether.success/5: Have you seen a zombified piglin? Are they as frightening as they sound?
playful.dialogue.story.nether.fail/1: Oh, honey, I highly doubt you've even glimpsed the fiery depths of the Nether.
playful.dialogue.story.nether.fail/2: Ah, so that's why those feisty Piglins decided to have a go at you. It all makes sense now.
playful.dialogue.story.nether.fail/3: Maybe you have been to the Nether, but that's still a dull story.
playful.dialogue.story.nether.fail/4: You don't look like you'd survive long in the Nether.
playful.dialogue.story.nether.fail/5: My grandpa explored the Nether and never mentioned warped fungus. Are you making that up?
playful.dialogue.story.enderdragon.succe: Astonishing! Did you actually manage to snatch the legendary dragon egg?
You beat the dragon? They'll be telling that tale for ages!
playful.dialogue.story.enderdragon.fail/: Ha! Are you out of your mind? The ender dragon is nothing but a fairytale.
You fought the ender dragon? Come on, that's hard to believe!
playful.dialogue.story.wither.success/1: Unbelievable! The Wither is like a walking disaster, but you just crushed it!
playful.dialogue.story.wither.success/2: No way! You actually defeated the Wither?! Mind officially blown!
playful.dialogue.story.wither.fail/1: Oh please, spare me the fairy tales.
playful.dialogue.story.wither.fail/2: Ha! You seem way too intact for me to buy that nonsense.
playful.dialogue.stay.fail/1: Thanks, but I want to keep exploring the world.
playful.dialogue.stay.fail/2: That's kind of you, but I'd rather see what's beyond the next hill.
playful.dialogue.stay.fail/3: This village is lovely, but I need to roam a little longer.
playful.dialogue.stay.repeat/1: You've already asked me that, silly!
playful.dialogue.stay.repeat/2: Oh dear player, it seems you've already graced me with your presence and asked that very question. My memory may be as sharp as a diamond sword, but it's clear as day that you've been here before.
playful.dialogue.stay.success/1: I'd love to call this village home!
playful.dialogue.stay.success/2: Yes! This village is just the place for me.
playful.dialogue.stay.no_space/1: Well, well, well, looks like this village is bursting at the seams, doesn't it?
playful.dialogue.stay.no_space/2: Oh, how I long to set up shop here, but alas, every bed in this bustling village has been claimed! It's like trying to find a needle in a haystack, my friend!
playful.dialogue.hire/1: Give me a shout when you need help. I'll be here for the emeralds!
playful.dialogue.hire/2: Glad to help! Just let me know when, and have the emeralds ready.
playful.dialogue.hire/3: Marvelous! I assure you, dear sir/madam, engaging my services will prove to be an absolutely delightful decision. Pray, prepare thy emeralds, for I shall be waiting with bated breath to embark on this grand endeavor of ours!
playful.dialogue.no_money/1: Sorry, you need more emeralds to hire me.
playful.dialogue.no_money/2: Not enough emeralds, I'm afraid. Even my talents have a price!
playful.dialogue.no_money/3: Ah, my good sir/madam, I must inform you that while my humble appearance may deceive, my unparalleled skills come at a price. And that price, my friend, is more emeralds than you currently possess.
playful.dialogue.main.rock_paper_scissor: Rock, paper, scissors? Prepare to meet a master!
playful.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor/1: Rock, paper, scissors! Let's see who's lucky.
playful.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor/2: Think you can win this time? Let's find out!
playful.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.rock: Boom! Rock it like a volcanic eruption!
playful.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.pape: Paper! The sneakiest choice of them all.
playful.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.scis: Brace yourself, my opponent, for the scissor is poised to claim victory in this epic battle!
playful.dialogue.rock_paper_scissor.loos: Oh, look at that! My paper just effortlessly crushed your rock. It's almost too easy for me. Better luck next time, pal!
Time to unleash the power of my scissors and leave your paper in tatters!
Well, well, well, looks like rock just bulldozed over scissor. I'm clearly not the sharpest tool in the shed.
Your paper beat my rock. Tricky move!
Scissors have prevailed, leaving my paper utterly defeated. I tip my metaphorical hat to you, my quick-thinking rival! Well played, well played indeed.
